title: Threat Model and Secret Boundaries
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Threat Model and Secret Boundaries.
learning_objectives: Explain threat model and secret boundaries using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for threat model and secret boundaries
Assess failure and operational limits of threat model and secret boundaries
concepts_covered: Encryption at rest protects a stolen data file only while the key/password remains secret; a running server can decrypt requested values.
The server checks x-api-token for API routes; it has no user roles or key rotation.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
